Description / Purpose: EBSD detector manufacturer, model, and camera resolution. Include whether EBSD and EDS are acquired simultaneously (common on modern combined EBSD-EDS systems).
Example / Allowed Content: e.g., 'Oxford AZtec Symmetry EBSD camera, 1244x1024 px' | 'Oxford Nordlys Nano' | 'Bruker QUANTAX EBSD e-Flash' | 'EDAX Hikari'

Description / Purpose: Algorithm used to index EBSD diffraction patterns and assign crystal orientations. Hough-transform methods fit Kikuchi band positions analytically; dictionary indexing (DI) matches experimental patterns to a pre-computed library of simulated patterns.
Example / Allowed Content: Hough transform | Dictionary indexing (DI) | Neural network | Other: specify | Unknown | N/A | None

Description / Purpose: Fraction of EBSD map points successfully indexed, expressed as a percentage of total map points. Low indexing rate may indicate surface damage, amorphisation, severe deformation, or phase misidentification.
Distance between adjacent EBSD measurement points in the map in nm or µm. Must be smaller than the smallest grain of interest to resolve grain boundary positions and intragrain orientation gradients.
Acquisition time per EBSD diffraction pattern frame in milliseconds. Longer frame time improves pattern quality and indexing rate but increases total acquisition time.

Mineral phases included in the EBSD reference pattern library for this procedure. The procedure specifies the expected phase suite for the target material; analysts may add phases for specific sample compositions.
Example / Allowed Content: e.g., 'Olivine (Fo90); enstatite; augite; plagioclase; ilmenite' | 'Troilite; pyrrhotite; kamacite; taenite'

Description / Purpose: Minimum pattern quality or confidence index threshold applied during EBSD data processing to exclude unreliably indexed points from orientation maps. Include metric name and threshold value.
Example / Allowed Content: e.g., 'Mean Angular Deviation (MAD) < 1.0 deg' | 'Confidence Index (CI) > 0.1' | 'Band contrast > 80'

Description / Purpose: Mean angular deviation (MAD) of the EBSD pattern indexing solution in degrees. MAD quantifies the misfit between experimental Kikuchi band positions and the best-fit crystal orientation. Values above ~1.5 degrees typically indicate unreliable indexing.
Crystal structure database used for EBSD phase identification and Kikuchi pattern simulation.
Example / Allowed Content: e.g., 'ICSD (Inorganic Crystal Structure Database)' | 'COD (Crystallography Open Database)' | 'Oxford AZtec Crystal built-in library'
